underspecified_points.hole: The public task dataset and the unit and proportions of the disjoint buffer/evaluation split are not identified.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must name Dc and lock whether splitting is by problem, template, or source group, together with the buffer/evaluation proportions; the choice must prevent related instances from crossing the split.

underspecified_points.hole: The rollout decoder and the rule for selecting prefix endpoints are unspecified even though they determine the student-state distribution represented by Bc.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must lock the student decoding distribution and a prefix-endpoint sampling rule, choosing whether the buffer represents uniformly sampled generation positions, a task-defined decision point, or another stated early-OPD state distribution.

underspecified_points.hole: The cached target distribution has no defined representation or required teacher-access interface.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must choose and lock the supervision object—full next-token probability vectors, a declared truncated distribution with residual mass, or sampled target sequences—and state the corresponding teacher interface and cache schema.

underspecified_points.hole: The micro-training objective, reduction, optimizer schedule, and stopping point are not defined.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must lock one loss compatible with the S2 target representation, its token/example reduction, the optimizer and schedule, and an exact shared number of update steps or supervised target tokens; every setting must be identical across TEACH and SELF.

underspecified_points.hole: R(c) is undefined when Hc is zero and unstable or sign-reversing when Hc is near zero or negative, but no reporting or ranking rule is stated.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must define, before examining downstream gains, the status and ranking treatment of Hc ≤ 0 and the criterion for declaring positive Hc too small for an interpretable ratio, while retaining the raw Hc and numerator and without silently clipping the denominator.

underspecified_points.hole: The teacher-family and data-distribution fold membership, whether each family statistic uses the held-out family or C_-f, and the aggregation across folds are unspecified.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must publish the family and data-group labels, resolve the held-out-set versus C_-f convention consistently with the linked equation, and lock whether fold correlations and regrets are pooled or summarized with an explicitly weighted rule.

underspecified_points.hole: The named overlap, margin, confidence, teacher-accuracy, and naive-early-gain baselines are not defined as estimators.
underspecified_points.fill: The authors must give each baseline an exact input, per-triad scalar formula, aggregation unit, and tie policy, then evaluate every baseline on exactly the same fold candidate sets and downstream gains as R(c).

enriched_steps.what_changes: Freeze a byte-identical initial student checkpoint θ0 together with its tokenizer, prompt template, decoding configuration, and random seed. Enumerate the selected public task dataset Dc with stable example identifiers and create a leakage-group identifier for examples that share a source, template, or derivation; assign whole leakage groups to the rollout pool or the fixed evaluation slice Ec, never both. 【author decision: name Dc and lock the split unit and buffer/evaluation proportions so related instances cannot cross the split.】 Run θ0 on each rollout-pool example and store every generated trajectory as a record containing triad_id, example_id, input x, reference-answer handle, prompt tokens, generated token identifiers, token log probabilities, and the selected prefix endpoint p. 【author decision: lock the rollout decoding distribution and the prefix-endpoint sampling rule that defines the early-student state distribution.】 Materialize Bc as an immutable table of (x,p) records and Ec as an immutable table of complete evaluation examples; write hashes of θ0, the tokenizer, both tables, and every sampling seed to a manifest reused by all later arms.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Freeze the exact initial student checkpoint θ0, its tokenizer, prompt format, generation settings, and random seed. Give every example in the chosen public task dataset Dc a stable identifier and a leakage-group identifier for related examples, then place whole groups either in the rollout pool or in the separate evaluation slice Ec. 【author decision: name Dc and lock the split unit and buffer/evaluation proportions so related examples cannot cross the split.】 Generate student trajectories from the rollout pool and save, for each trajectory, the input, reference-answer handle, prompt tokens, generated token identifiers, token probabilities, and the point p where the prefix ends. 【author decision: lock the student generation distribution and the rule for choosing prefix endpoints so Bc has a defined early-student state distribution.】 Store these prefix records as the immutable buffer Bc, store complete evaluation examples as Ec, and record hashes and random seeds so every later arm reads exactly the same objects.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 冻结完全相同的初始学生检查点(checkpoint) θ0，并同时锁定分词器、提示模板、生成设置和随机种子。为选定的公开任务数据 Dc 中每个样本分配稳定标识，并为来源、模板或派生关系相同的样本分配防泄漏分组；随后按整组把样本放入轨迹池或独立评估切片 Ec，不能交叉。 【作者需决定：明确 Dc，并锁定拆分单位及缓冲区与评估集的比例，确保相关样本不会跨集合。】 用轨迹池生成学生作答过程，并为每条过程保存输入、参考答案句柄、提示词元、生成词元标识、词元概率以及前缀结束位置 p。 【作者需决定：锁定学生生成分布和前缀结束位置的选取规则，使 Bc 对应明确的早期学生状态分布。】 将这些前缀记录保存为不可变缓冲区 Bc，将完整评估样本保存为 Ec，并记录检查点、分词器、数据表的哈希值和全部随机种子，供后续分支原样复用。

enriched_steps.what_changes: For every immutable (x,p) record in Bc, reconstruct the exact prompt-plus-prefix token sequence and submit that identical sequence to the candidate teacher Tc and frozen student θ0. Produce one completion from each source under a locked decoding rule, retain the completion token identifiers and stop reason, parse the final answer with the task's deterministic canonicalizer, and apply the exact-answer verifier V to obtain a scalar in {0,1}. Calculate Hc as the equal-weight mean of the paired teacher-minus-student verifier scores, and retain the per-record pair so the aggregate is reproducible. In the same record, cache the supervision object supplied by each source with its attention mask, token positions, vocabulary mapping, and normalization metadata. 【author decision: choose full next-token probabilities, a declared truncated distribution with residual mass, or sampled target sequences, and lock the teacher interface and cache schema required by that choice.】 Reject records only for declared interface failures, log their identifiers and reasons, and derive both the teacher and frozen-self caches from the same retained Bc index set.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For each fixed (x,p) record in Bc, rebuild exactly the same prompt and prefix and give it to the candidate teacher Tc and frozen student θ0. Generate one completion from each using a locked generation rule, save its tokens and stopping reason, convert its final answer to the task's canonical answer format, and use the exact-answer verifier V to assign 1 for correct or 0 for incorrect. Average the paired teacher score minus student score with equal weight across records to obtain Hc, while keeping every paired score. Also cache each source's training target together with token positions, masks, vocabulary mapping, and normalization information. 【author decision: choose full next-token probabilities, a stated truncated probability distribution with its omitted mass, or sampled target sequences, and lock the teacher interface and cache layout for that choice.】 Use the same successfully processed record identifiers for the teacher and frozen-self caches.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对 Bc 中每条固定的 (x,p) 记录，重建完全相同的提示与前缀词元序列，并分别交给候选教师 Tc 和冻结学生 θ0。按照锁定的生成规则各生成一个续写，保存词元和停止原因，把最终答案转换成任务规定的标准形式，再由精确答案验证器 V 以 1 表示正确、0 表示错误。对每条记录的教师得分减学生得分等权取平均，得到 Hc，同时保留全部成对得分。还要缓存两种来源的训练目标，并保存词元位置、掩码、词表映射和归一化信息。 【作者需决定：在完整的下一词元概率、带已声明剩余概率质量的截断分布、采样目标序列三者中选择监督表示，并锁定相应的教师接口和缓存结构。】 教师缓存与冻结学生自身缓存必须使用完全相同的成功记录标识集合。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Create θcTEACH and θcSELF as byte-identical copies of θ0 and attach separate optimizer states initialized from the same configuration. Build one ordered training index over Bc; for every index, TEACH reads Tc's cached supervision object and SELF reads θ0's cached object, while input prefixes, example weights, batch boundaries, number of supervised target tokens, update count, learning-rate positions, and random-number streams remain matched. Optimize both arms with the same token-level distillation loss and reduction. 【author decision: lock the loss compatible with the S2 supervision representation, its reduction, optimizer and schedule, and the exact shared stopping point in updates or supervised target tokens.】 The SELF targets always come from the frozen cache and are never refreshed from the evolving SELF checkpoint. Save both final checkpoints plus a manifest containing cache hashes, ordered record identifiers, per-step token counts, optimizer settings, seeds, and training-loss traces, so target source is the only intentional arm-level difference.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Make two exact copies of θ0: the candidate-teacher arm TEACH and the frozen-self arm SELF. Initialize separate optimizer states from the same settings and feed both arms the same ordered Bc records, batches, example weights, number of supervised target tokens, update steps, schedule positions, and random-number streams. TEACH reads the cached targets produced by Tc; SELF reads the targets produced once by frozen θ0, never targets from the changing SELF model. Train both with the same token-level distillation rule. 【author decision: lock the training loss that matches the target representation, how token losses are combined, the optimizer and schedule, and the exact shared stopping point.】 Save both trained checkpoints and a manifest of cache hashes, record order, token counts, settings, seeds, and loss traces so the intended difference is only the target source.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 从 θ0 制作两个完全相同的副本：候选教师分支 TEACH 和冻结学生自身分支 SELF。用同一组设置初始化各自的优化器状态，并让两个分支读取顺序相同的 Bc 记录、批次、样本权重、监督目标词元数、更新步数、学习率进度位置和随机数流。TEACH 读取 Tc 生成的缓存目标；SELF 只读取冻结 θ0 预先生成的目标，绝不能改用训练过程中不断变化的 SELF 模型生成目标。两个分支采用同一套词元级蒸馏训练规则。 【作者需决定：锁定与监督表示相匹配的损失、词元损失的汇总方式、优化器与调度规则，以及两个分支完全相同的停止点。】 保存两个训练后检查点，并保存缓存哈希、记录顺序、词元数、设置、随机种子和损失轨迹，使目标来源成为唯一有意设置的分支差异。

enriched_steps.what_changes: Evaluate θ0, θcTEACH, and θcSELF on the identical ordered Ec records using the same prompt formatter, decoding rule, answer canonicalizer, verifier V, and seed policy. Store one verifier score per checkpoint and example, and define M as their equal-weight mean over Ec. Calculate ΔcTEACH and ΔcSELF from the linked outcome-change definition, then calculate the Teacher-Causal Response R(c) from the linked excess-response definition using the Hc produced in S2. Persist a per-triad record containing Hc, both outcome changes, their raw difference, R(c), the number of valid evaluation records, and hashes of all three checkpoints and Ec. Do not clip or replace Hc. 【author decision: predeclare how Hc ≤ 0 and positive but near-zero Hc are labeled and treated in ranking, including the criterion for an uninterpretable ratio, while always retaining the raw denominator and numerator.】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Evaluate θ0, θcTEACH, and θcSELF on the same ordered Ec examples with the same prompt format, generation rule, answer canonicalizer, exact-answer verifier V, and random-seed policy. Save each model's 0-or-1 score on every example and let M be the average score over Ec. Use the linked definitions to calculate each trained arm's change from θ0 and then the Teacher-Causal Response Probe (TCR-Probe) score R(c), using Hc from S2. Save Hc, both changes, their difference, R(c), the number of valid examples, and hashes of the checkpoints and Ec in one triad record. Never clip or replace Hc. 【author decision: define how zero, negative, and positive but near-zero Hc values are labeled and handled in ranking, including when the ratio is considered uninterpretable, while retaining the raw values.】
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 在顺序完全相同的 Ec 样本上评估 θ0、θcTEACH 和 θcSELF，三者必须使用相同的提示格式、生成规则、答案标准化程序、精确答案验证器 V 和随机种子规则。保存每个模型在每个样本上的 0 或 1 得分，并把 M 定义为 Ec 上的平均得分。按照本步骤关联的定义，先计算两个训练分支相对 θ0 的结果变化，再用 S2 得到的 Hc 计算教师因果响应探针(Teacher-Causal Response Probe, TCR-Probe)分数 R(c)。在一条三元组记录中保存 Hc、两个结果变化、二者之差、R(c)、有效样本数以及三个检查点和 Ec 的哈希值。不得截断或替换 Hc。 【作者需决定：预先规定 Hc 为零、为负以及为正但接近零时如何标记和参与排序，包括何时判定比值不可解释，同时保留原始分子和分母。】

enriched_steps.what_changes: Build one locked triad table with columns triad_id, teacher_family, data_group, R(c), Hc, frozen-student exact-answer score, post-OPD exact-answer score, and full-run gain G_OPD(c), where each post-OPD model starts from its triad's θ0 and follows the same fixed 5M-token OPD protocol. Freeze all labels and scores before ranking. 【author decision: publish teacher-family and data-group membership, resolve whether each family statistic is evaluated on the held-out family or on C_-f as written in the linked equation, and lock the pooling or weighting rule across folds.】 Within every locked evaluation candidate set, assign average ranks to ties and calculate the linked Spearman rank agreement between R(c) and G_OPD(c). Define top-three selection regret as the mean G_OPD(c) of the oracle's three highest-gain triads minus the mean gain of the three triads selected by R(c), with a deterministic triad_id tie break. Implement overlap, margin, confidence, teacher-accuracy, and naive-early-gain as one scalar column per triad. 【author decision: define each baseline's exact inputs, formula, aggregation unit, and tie policy before comparing it on the identical candidate sets.】 Report per-fold and aggregate rank agreement and top-three regret for R(c) and every baseline without fitting or recalibrating R(c) on any held-out scores.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: Create one fixed table with each triad's identifier, teacher-family label, data-group label, R(c), Hc, frozen-student exact-answer score, exact-answer score after full on-policy distillation (OPD), and their full-run gain G_OPD(c). Each full OPD run must start from that triad's θ0 and use the same fixed 5M-token protocol. Freeze the table before ranking. 【author decision: publish the teacher-family and data-group assignments, resolve whether each family fold is scored on the held-out family or on C_-f from the linked equation, and lock how fold results are combined.】 In each fixed candidate set, give tied values their average rank and calculate Spearman rank correlation between R(c) and G_OPD(c). Calculate top-three regret as the oracle top three triads' mean full-run gain minus the mean gain of the three selected by R(c), breaking remaining ties by triad identifier. 【author decision: give overlap, margin, confidence, teacher accuracy, and uncorrected early gain exact per-triad formulas, inputs, aggregation units, and tie rules.】 Apply R(c) and every baseline unchanged to the same folds and report both rank correlation and top-three regret for each.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 建立一张固定的三元组表，包含三元组标识、教师家族标签、数据分组标签、R(c)、Hc、冻结学生的精确答案得分、完整在线策略蒸馏(On-Policy Distillation, OPD)后的精确答案得分，以及完整训练增益 G_OPD(c)。每次完整 OPD 都必须从该三元组的 θ0 开始，并遵循同一套固定 5M 词元流程；排序前冻结整张表。 【作者需决定：公布教师家族和数据分组归属，明确每个教师家族折是在被留出的家族上统计，还是按关联公式在 C_-f 上统计，并锁定各折结果的合并或加权规则。】 在每个固定候选集合内，对并列数值使用平均名次，再计算 R(c) 与 G_OPD(c) 的 Spearman 等级相关。将排名前三的选择后悔值定义为：真实增益最高的三个三元组的平均完整训练增益，减去 R(c) 选出的三个三元组的平均增益；仍有并列时按三元组标识确定顺序。 【作者需决定：为重叠度、间隔、置信度、教师准确率和未经校正的早期增益分别给出精确的逐三元组输入、公式、汇总单位和并列处理规则。】 在同一批留出折上原样应用 R(c) 和全部基线，并分别报告等级相关与排名前三的选择后悔值，不能用留出得分重新拟合或校准 R(c)。

enriched_steps.what_changes: For each triad with |Bc| ≥ 2, sort Bc records by a stable hash of triad_id and example_id, then assign every record the candidate-teacher supervision object from the next record in the circular order. This one-position cyclic derangement guarantees no prefix keeps its own teacher target while preserving the target cache as an identical multiset, including token lengths, values, and sampling weights. Leave the input-prefix table, SELF cache, θ0 initialization, ordered training indices, batch boundaries, update count, optimizer settings, random-number streams, Ec, V, and the original Hc unchanged. Train the placebo TEACH checkpoint using the S3 procedure with only the teacher-cache lookup permuted; evaluate it through S4 and substitute its excess outcome change into the same response definition. Insert the resulting placebo response into the locked S5 triad table and calculate the same fold rankings, Spearman correlations, and top-three regret, retaining the permutation map and hashes so the broken alignment is auditable.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_en: For every triad with at least two Bc records, sort the records by a stable hash of the triad and example identifiers. Give each prefix the candidate-teacher target from the next record in that circular order. This guarantees that no prefix keeps its own target while preserving exactly the same collection of targets, lengths, values, and sampling weights. Keep the prefixes, SELF targets, θ0 initialization, training-record order, batches, update steps, optimizer settings, random-number streams, Ec, verifier V, and original Hc unchanged. Train the placebo TEACH checkpoint exactly as in S3 except for the permuted target lookup, evaluate it as in S4, and use its excess outcome change in the same response definition. Put the placebo response into the same S5 triad table and calculate the same fold rankings, Spearman correlations, and top-three regret. Save the permutation map and hashes.
enriched_steps.what_to_do_zh: 对每个至少含两条 Bc 记录的三元组，按照三元组标识和样本标识的稳定哈希值排序。把循环顺序中的下一条候选教师目标分配给当前前缀。这样可保证没有前缀保留自己的目标，同时完整保留目标集合、序列长度、数值和采样权重。前缀、SELF 目标、θ0 初始化、训练记录顺序、批次、更新步数、优化器设置、随机数流、Ec、验证器 V 和原始 Hc 都保持不变。除教师目标查询被置换外，严格按 S3 训练安慰剂 TEACH 检查点，再按 S4 评估，并把它相对 SELF 的结果变化代入同一响应定义。将安慰剂响应写入同一张 S5 三元组表，计算相同的分折排序、Spearman 等级相关和排名前三的选择后悔值，并保存置换映射与哈希值。
